question: What is the name of the indigenously developed High-Speed Expandable Aerial Target System which was successfully flight-tested by Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhyas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abhyas** is an indigenously developed High-Speed Expandable Aerial Target (HEAT) system designed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**.
 
• The system was successfully flight-tested in December 2021 at the **Integrated Test Range (ITR), Chandipur, Odisha**.
 
• It is used as a target for evaluating various missile systems and air defence systems.
 
• Abhyas is powered by a small gas turbine engine and is equipped with a MEMS-based inertial navigation system for high precision.
 
• The aerial target features a **locally developed radar cross-section (RCS) and infrared (IR) signature augmentation**, making it highly effective for testing purposes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**

 
 
• DRDO is India's premier research organization responsible for developing defence systems and technologies.
 
• It was established in 1958 and operates under the Ministry of Defence.
 
• DRDO has been instrumental in creating numerous indigenous defence technologies, including missiles, radars, and electronic warfare systems.
 
 
 
• **High-Speed Expandable Aerial Target (HEAT)**
 
 
• HEAT systems are unmanned aerial vehicles designed to simulate enemy aircraft or missiles for testing purposes.
 
• They are used to evaluate the performance of air defence systems, weaponry, and radar systems.
 
• Such systems are critical for training and developing military operational capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Test Range (ITR), Chandipur**
 
 
• ITR is a premier test facility located in Odisha, India, under DRDO.
 
• It is used for testing missiles, aerial targets, and other defence systems.
 
• The range is equipped with advanced tracking and monitoring systems to ensure precise evaluation during tests.
 
 
 
• **MEMS-based Inertial Navigation System**
 
 
• MEMS stands for Micro-Electromechanical Systems, a technology used in navigation systems for high precision.
 
• These systems rely on accelerometers and gyroscopes to provide location and orientation information.
 
• MEMS-based systems are compact, reliable, and widely used in modern aerospace applications.
